geography_note: State geography is assigned directly from Grantee State. County/county-equivalent matches combine high-confidence direct county text with the primary county listed for a conservatively matched city/place. City/place geography uses point locations from the supplied U.S. cities database and is not a municipal-boundary layer. A city-derived county is an approximation for places that span more than one county. The 2010 Census urban-area layer is retained as a secondary analytical geography and is linked by matched city point-in-polygon where possible.
narrative_join_note: Sanitized narratives are linked to finance records by exact Grant + Activity Number + QPR quarter. Narrative-only filtering requires a nonempty sanitized narrative. Retained infrastructure/multifamily addresses are highlighted; potential single-family or ambiguous addresses are replaced with a redaction marker.
city_data_attribution: City/place coordinates and primary-county attributes are derived from the user-supplied SimpleMaps U.S. Cities database. The free database requires visible SimpleMaps attribution.
narrative_privacy_screening: Automated activity-aware address screening; retained public addresses are limited to infrastructure/public-facility or clearly multifamily/rental narratives. Potential single-family, homeowner, buyout, rehabilitation/reconstruction, relocation, and ambiguous addresses are redacted.
privacy_review_note: Automated screening is conservative and does not replace legal or human privacy review. The restricted QA file containing original detected address spans must not be published.
deployment_runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript for GitHub Pages; no server process
static_finance_storage: Dictionary-encoded JavaScript row chunks loaded in the visitor browser
static_narrative_storage: Year-partitioned JavaScript chunks containing privacy-screened public narrative excerpts loaded on demand
